en: Vintage sepia postcard view of a riverside scene with a tram in the foreground on curved tracks beside a cobblestone embankment. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the river. On the hill across the river stands a large Gothic complex with tall cathedral towers and adjoining palace‑like buildings. At the top left of the card, in red print, is the caption 'Meissen.  Kgl. Albrechtsburg.'
